Section 4

People and experiences

The people who use the platform, what each of them needs, and the journeys that test whether they get it.

The platform has five lenses, one for each kind of work. The front door is for people who are not signed in. The member lens shows what is mine and what I can do next. The club lens is for a club's officers. The programme lens works across all clubs within one programme. The federation lens is for staff and officers running the whole.

Each person below is tested by journeys: short stories the build walks against itself, rated meets, guarded, open, not built or fails. The sixteen canonical journeys, J01 to J16, are the stories every version of the design has had to pass.

Demo people in the prototype are fictional, and none is named here.

Front door lens

28 journeys: 16 meet · 10 guarded · 2 open · 0 not built · 0 fail
Visitor

Someone not signed in: a prospective member, a relative or a member of the public reading about AFRP.

New member

A person joining for the first time, alone, as a family, as a student or as a newlywed.

Member lens

119 journeys: 93 meet · 12 guarded · 5 open · 8 not built · 1 fail
Member

A signed-in member with a national membership and usually one or more club memberships.

Household parent or guardian

An adult acting for minors in a household: registering, applying to camp, declaring births and naming who may collect a child.

Young person

A minor in a member household, and the same person at eighteen when their consents become their own.

Donor

A member or friend of AFRP giving to a cause or fund, including restricted appeals and the endowment.

Delegate and voter

A member voting in federation elections, and a delegate carrying a club's weighted vote at convention.

Club lens

43 journeys: 31 meet · 6 guarded · 2 open · 4 not built · 0 fail
Club officer

A president, secretary or other officer of one chapter club.

Club treasurer

The officer who collects dues and club money and remits AFRP's share.

Programme lens

92 journeys: 69 meet · 11 guarded · 4 open · 8 not built · 0 fail
Programme organiser

A programme chair, reviewer, editor or staff member whose scope crosses every club for one programme.

Federation lens

111 journeys: 65 meet · 24 guarded · 3 open · 19 not built · 0 fail
Committee member

A member serving on a committee such as the Family Tree, Scholarship or Membership Committee.

Federation staff and officers

National officers and staff running membership, money, governance and the registries.

What is real here. By-law citations, decisions and the Federation's own strategy documents are real. People, households and money shown in the prototype and its fixture are fictional. No living person is named on these pages (D50).

Generated from davidsaah/afrp-strategy. Precedence (D41): the by-law texts, then the Decisions Register and design documents, then the prototype, then the Hub's code. Where the record is silent, these pages say so.
